The paper proposes an ITS that includes a RAG-based content generation layer (Gemini within a RAG framework) and runs experiments (simulated and a user study). The RAG component is part of the evaluated system. The vision module is for engagement detection, not multimodal RAG, so E9 does not apply. Under the rules, a paper that runs experiments with a system containing a RAG component suggests INCLUDE, though RAG is not the main focus and its contribution is not evaluated in isolation. I lean INCLUDE rather than MAYBE, since the rules say to include when the paper proposes or evaluates a system with RAG.

{"decision": "INCLUDE", "code": null, "reason": "Proposes and evaluates a tutoring system with RAG-based content generation (Gemini), with simulated and user experiments."}
